items.statement: The submitted fixed BiBr4 fragment optimization is converged and frequency analysis tests whether it is a minimum.
items.expected: Convergence, frequency completion and imaginary-frequency handling are explicitly documented.

items.statement: Six distinct low-frequency modes of the supplied Bi/Br fragment are identified with reproducible assignments.
items.expected: Six modes in the requested region are individually retained and assigned to Bi/Br motions.

items.statement: The reported optimized structure is quantitatively compared to the local crystallographic geometry references.
items.expected: Distance and angle MAE with units and explicit pairing are reported.

items.statement: The six assigned computed modes are quantitatively compared to the observed low-frequency Raman references.
items.expected: A six-mode RMSD in cm−1 and explicit pairing are reported.
